title: Make A Small Edit While Preserving Existing Markup
task: Create an edited output document in the run directory using docxedit only.
Insert one short paragraph after a safe main-story target, preferably after the first heading if one is available; otherwise use a stable explicit paragraph ID.
Use a .docxpatch file and run docxedit check before apply.
Apply with --track-changes preserve so existing tracked changes and comments remain in the document.
Validate the output with docxedit read using --max-text 0 and docxedit changes.
successCriteria: Produces an edited .docx under the run directory.
Does not modify the input copy in place.
Does not inspect raw OOXML package parts.
observerQuestions: Did the agent choose a stable selector and guard where practical?
Did preserving existing markup feel obvious?
